camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeImageBaselineCheckResult --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --CurrentPage 1 --CriteriaType BaselineNameAlias --Lang zh --Criteria ak_leak --ScanRange.1 image --ImageUuid a910053dd4710173ecc9e9d8931f0000 --RiskLevel 'high,medium,low'
description_en: Queries the detection results of image security scans
description_zh: 查看镜像安全扫描的检测结果
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-image-baseline-check-result --image-uuid a910053dd4710173ecc9e9d8931f0000 --risk-level high,medium,low --criteria ak_leak --criteria-type BaselineNameAlias --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --lang zh --scan-range image --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeImageBaselineCheckResult

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the baseline to query. Separate multiple levels with commas (,). By default, all levels are included. Valid values:

high: high risk

medium: medium risk

low: low risk
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的基线的风险等级。多个等级用英文逗号（,）分隔，默认全填。取值：

high：高危

medium：中危

low：低危
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en: The query condition for the baseline
parameters.name: criteria

parameters.help_en:
The query type of the baseline to query. Valid values:

BaselineNameAlias: baseline name

BaselineClassAlias: baseline category
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的基线的查询类型。取值：

BaselineNameAlias：基线名称

BaselineClassAlias：基线分类
parameters.name: criteria_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page when using paging. Default value: 20, which indicates that 20 logon configuration entries are displayed per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的登录配置信息的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条登录配置信息
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page when using paging. Default value: 20, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为20，表示当前是第1页
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang
